title: Analytical Procedures (Assay/NIR)[Assay][Sakura Bloom 20 mg]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Assay/NIR)[Assay][Sakura Bloom 20 mg].

action.title: Technique
action.description: Analytical procedure principle: ·       Transmission NIR to determine the individual content of tablet cores containing Sakuramil.

action.title: Aperture setting
action.description: Open (sample measurement),  Internal reference spectralon (background measurement)

action.title: Spectral pre-processing
action.description: 17 points Savitzky-Golay 1st derivative + Standard Normal Variate (SNV) on 12500 - 4000 cm-1

action.title: System suitability test (SST)
action.description: The system suitability test of the specific measurement channel of the NIR instrument involves the execution of the Bruker Performance Qualification (PQ) test prior to data acquisition.

action.title: Number of units to be tested
Quantification analysis
action.description: The measured NIR spectra are evaluated using the NIRS model cited above and single results for each tablet with the associated statistical spectral quality test is calculated.

action.title: Assessment (assay)
action.description: Calculate the mean of all individual tablet contents and report it as result for assay.
